We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Strategist to put our AI agents to work inside healthcare organizations. Most of your time goes to designing and deploying agentic workflows with customers. The rest goes to turning what you learn into product. You have a CS or similarly quantitative background, think in systems, understand how LLMs actually behave, and love working with customers.
   

  

**About Clicks**
 Our mission is to accelerate the world’s transition to autonomous operations. We’re starting with healthcare revenue cycle management. We build AI agents that do anything from prior auth to denial management and payment posting, working in the same EHRs, payer portals and phone calls that billing teams use today. Customers get 90%\+ of the work fully automated, go live in under 5 weeks, and are guaranteed 50%\+ cost savings.
   

  

 Why now: payers use AI to deny claims, and providers who don’t fight back with AI fall behind. Billing teams also churn because the work is repetitive. Our agents take that work off their plate.
   

  

* Investors: Y Combinator, 20VC, Fly Ventures, Yellow. $4\.5M raised.
* Team: Small, technical, founder\-led. You work directly with the founders.


**The Role**
 You own deployments end to end: learn how a customer’s team does the work today, translate it into logic our agents follow reliably, prove it works, and take it live.
   

  

 Let’s be direct: this is mostly deployment work. If you mainly want to own a roadmap, this isn’t the role. If you want to learn what to build by doing the work with customers, it is. At an AI agent company, the people who know what to build are the ones who deployed it. Deployment is the path into product here, not a toll you pay before it.
   

  

 You don’t need to write production code. You do need to be exceptionally sharp at logic, able to reason about where an LLM will succeed or fail, and able to earn the trust of a revenue cycle director in the first meeting.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
*Deploy agentic workflows (\~80%)*
* Run customer kickoffs and map workflows like prior auth, eligibility, denial management and payment posting, down to every step and every exception.
* Turn SOPs into agent instructions, decision logic and escalation rules.
* Evaluate agents on historical cases, run supervised pilots with the customer’s team, then roll out incrementally.
* Debug production failures: figure out whether it’s the instructions, a missing rule, a portal quirk or a model limitation, then fix it or drive it with engineering.
* Track automation rate, accuracy and cost per workflow, and present results to customer leadership to drive expansion.


*Shape the product (\~20%)*
* Spot what repeats across deployments and turn one\-off fixes into reusable product: templates, tooling, evals.
* Work side by side with engineering to cut time\-to\-live and effort per workflow.
* Bring the customer’s reality into every product decision.


**Required**
**Who You Are**
* Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering or another quantitative field.
* New grad to 2 years of work experience. This role is built for early\-career people.
* You genuinely enjoy working with customers, including the unglamorous parts. You’ve done tedious work to get a result and it didn’t bother you.
* Customer\-facing experience of any kind: consulting or client internships, founding something, sales, teaching.
* You understand LLMs beyond the hype: context, prompting, tool use, evals, and where models break.
* Exceptional structured thinking. You turn messy processes into clear logic.
* Comfortable reading code, logs and JSON, even though you won’t write production code.


*Nice to have*
* You’ve built with LLMs: side projects, agents, prompt pipelines, evals.
* Exposure to healthcare, revenue cycle or other operations\-heavy industries.

Role Overview
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Full Stack Software Engineer** 
 to design, implement, and QA large customer features, end\-to\-end. In this role, you’ll work with product and design teams to scope emergent customer needs and design and implement solutions across our entire stack.
   

  

 What You’ll Do

 Why Join JustAI
   

  

* High ownership, high impact \- your work defines how AI meets real customer workflows
* Founding\-stage startup backed by YC \& Peak XV (Sequoia), and growing fast
* Work with leadership from Twitter, Pinterest, and Goldman Sachs
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity

**Responsibilities**
 We build the next\-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e\-commerce customer service — running in 30\+ languages across one of the largest e\-commerce surfaces on the internet.
   

  

 Our north star is a self\-evolving Agent: post\-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill\-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root\-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails.
   

  

 Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work:
   

  

* We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude\-Code\-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API.
* Evaluation and experimentation are first\-class systems, not an afterthought. A self\-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change.


 By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross\-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets.
   

  

 We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. PhD internships at Our Company provide students with the opportunity to actively contribute to our products and research, as well as to the organization's future plans and emerging technologies.
   

  

 Our dynamic internship experience blends hands\-on learning, enriching community\-building and professional development events, and collaboration with industry experts.
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume (Start date, End date).
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control \& intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior\-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre\-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve\-time gates, shadow / swap\-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths.
* Context \& memory for long multi\-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note\-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just\-in\-time (retrieve\-then\-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever\-growing prompt.
* Post\-training \& the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals.
* Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools\-as\-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill\-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross\-skill mis\-fire matrices, and on\-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context.
* Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM\-as\-judge with human\-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held\-out and time\-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross\-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale.
* The self\-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root\-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read\-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round.
* Online experimentation \& causal readout. Shadow / canary / A\-B, non\-inferiority gates, traffic\-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off\-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible.


**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research or a related technical discipline
* Strong Python plus one of C\+\+ / Go / Rust / Java
* Solid ML / DL / NLP fundamentals, with genuine hands\-on experience with LLMs or agents (coursework, research, internship, competition, open\-source, or a serious side project)
* Basic statistical literacy — you can compute a confidence interval, explain what a p\-value does and doesn't mean, and tell the difference between "the number went up" and "the system got better"
* Able to read a paper or an engineering blog and turn it into working code


 Preferred Qualifications
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in any one of the following — depth in one is enough, breadth welcome:
* Post\-training: SFT / DPO / RLHF / RLAIF / RLVR, reward modeling, reward hacking and how to defend against it
* Agent systems: harness, context engineering, MCP / Skills, sub\-agents, tool search
* Evaluation \& experimentation: LLM\-as\-judge and judge calibration, pass^k, regression suites, A/B and non\-inferiority testing, off\-policy evaluation
* Self\-improving / evolutionary systems: evolutionary program search, candidate archives and parent sampling, automatic prompt / context optimization, multi\-objective (Pareto) selection and credit assignment
* Publications (for PhD), strong competition results (ACM\-ICPC / Kaggle / ML competitions), or notable open\-source contributions
* E\-commerce or multilingual experience is a plus, not required

**About The Role**
 Twitch's Enterprise Platform \& Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build the systems where SAP meets AWS — extending our enterprise ERP with cloud\-native services and agentic AI to power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you'll work on SAP\-side development (ABAP, CDS, RAP, OData) and AWS\-native engineering (Lambda, Step Functions, MCP servers, Bedrock, CDK) — owning integrations end\-to\-end.
   

  

 You'll work at the intersection of SAP enterprise systems and modern cloud engineering — building AWS\-hosted APIs and pipelines that talk to SAP, standing up agentic AI tooling (MCP servers, Bedrock agents, Claude\-powered workflows) that automates Finance operations, and shipping production AWS services alongside SAP customizations. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with SAP \+ AWS \+ AI is up to you. We're looking for an SAP developer whose toolkit has grown past the ERP — someone who writes ABAP inside SAP GUI and is just as ready to pick up Python or TypeScript to ship the cloud half of their own integration, and who raises the bar on automation along the way.
   

  

**You Will**
*Build in SAP*
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between SAP (S/4HANA, BTP) and downstream systems — owning the full lifecycle from design through operations
* Write ABAP, SAP HANA SQL, and CDS views to implement business logic, reports, and data transformations within the SAP ecosystem
* Design, build, and maintain SAP APIs — OData services (SEGW / RAP), RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, and RFC\-based interfaces — for consumption by external systems, Fiori apps, and AWS\-hosted middleware


*Extend it with AWS and agentic AI*
* Build and operate AWS\-native services (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, Amazon ECR) that extend SAP capabilities beyond the traditional ERP boundary
* Deploy and manage the AWS infrastructure behind your integrations using CDK (TypeScript/Python) — including CI/CD pipelines, IAM roles, VPC/VPCE connectivity to SAP, and multi\-environment topology (beta/gamma/prod)
* Design, build, and ship agentic AI systems on top of your SAP APIs — MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock\-based agents, and Claude\-powered workflows — that automate Finance operations like reconciliations, reporting, variance analysis, and payout workflows
* Build data pipelines that move financial data between SAP, Redshift, and enterprise applications


*Cross\-cutting*
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions delivered across SAP and AWS
* Own production systems end\-to\-end — deployment, monitoring, incident response, and iterative improvement
* Improve engineering practices on the team through code reviews, documentation, and mentoring


**You Have**
*SAP*
* 4\+ years of hands\-on SAP development experience (ABAP, HANA SQL, CDS views, BTP, or SAP integration technologies like BAPIs, RFC)
* Experience building integrations using File\-Based and API\-Based (REST, OData, SOAP) patterns
* Experience with the S/4HANA top\-down development approach — CDS views (with associations, annotations, parameters) and AMDP classes to push data processing to HANA from the ABAP layer


*AWS and AI*
* Hands\-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, API Gateway, or similar) — deploying and operating production workloads
* Proficiency in at least one modern language beyond ABAP — Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java — with a demonstrated track record of shipping production code
* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) — writing, deploying, and reviewing IaC in a team setting
* Demonstrated heavy use of AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Bedrock, or similar) integrated into your daily engineering workflow — code generation, data analysis, automation, and problem\-solving


*Shared*
* Experience testing and debugging APIs using tools like Bruno or Postman — building request collections, handling authentication flows, and validating response contracts

* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Template Method) and SOLID principles
* Finance domain knowledge — familiarity with FI/CO, FI/CA, AP, AR or GL


**Bonus Points**

* Experience building Fiori applications using the RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP) — including business object definition, behavior implementation (managed, unmanaged, or hybrid), and service binding/exposure

**Responsibilities**
 Team Introduction:
   

  

 We build the next\-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e\-Commerce customer service — running in 30\+ languages across one of the largest e\-Commerce surfaces on the internet.
   

  

 Our north star is a self\-evolving Agent: post\-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill\-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root\-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails.
   

  

 Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work:
   

  

* We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude\-Code\-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API.
* Evaluation and experimentation are first\-class systems, not an afterthought. A self\-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change.


 By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross\-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets.
   

  

 We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis \- we encourage you to apply early.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control \& intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior\-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre\-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve\-time gates, shadow / swap\-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths.
* Context \& memory for long multi\-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note\-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just\-in\-time (retrieve\-then\-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever\-growing prompt.
* Post\-training \& the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals.
* Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools\-as\-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill\-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross\-skill mis\-fire matrices, and on\-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context.
* Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM\-as\-judge with human\-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held\-out and time\-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross\-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale.
* The self\-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root\-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read\-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round.
* Online experimentation \& causal readout. Shadow / canary / A\-B, non\-inferiority gates, traffic\-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off\-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible.


**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualification(s):
   

  

* Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline

* Solid ML / DL / NLP fundamentals, with genuine hands\-on experience with LLMs or agents (coursework, research, internship, competition, open\-source, or a serious side project)

**Responsibilities**
 Team Introduction:
   

  

 We build the next\-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e\-Commerce customer service — running in 30\+ languages across one of the largest e\-Commerce surfaces on the internet.
   

  

 Our north star is a self\-evolving Agent: post\-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill\-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root\-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails.
   

  

 Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work:
   

  

* We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude\-Code\-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API.
* Evaluation and experimentation are first\-class systems, not an afterthought. A self\-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change.


 By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross\-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets.
   

  

 We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis \- we encourage you to apply early.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control \& intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior\-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre\-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve\-time gates, shadow / swap\-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths.
* Context \& memory for long multi\-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note\-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just\-in\-time (retrieve\-then\-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever\-growing prompt.
* Post\-training \& the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals.
* Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools\-as\-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill\-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross\-skill mis\-fire matrices, and on\-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context.
* Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM\-as\-judge with human\-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held\-out and time\-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross\-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale.
* The self\-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root\-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read\-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round.
* Online experimentation \& causal readout. Shadow / canary / A\-B, non\-inferiority gates, traffic\-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off\-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible.

 leverages advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, and AI to solve complex business challenges and enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. **Career Summary**
 The American Nurses Enterprise (ANE) is seeking a Data Scientist, Test Security to help safeguard the validity, integrity, and credibility of its certification programs. This role applies data forensics, advanced analytics, and investigative expertise to identify anomalies, assess security risks, and detect emerging trends. The Data Scientist manages the full data lifecycle by gathering, preparing, validating, and analyzing information from multiple systems and sources. In collaboration with cross\-functional teams, this position leads initiatives that strengthen test security practices, improve operational processes, and enhance program effectiveness. The role also develops clear, meaningful reports, dashboards, and presentations that translate complex findings into actionable insights for strategic and operational decision\-making.
   

  

 Join the American Nurses Enterprise (ANE) and be part of the team building a healthy world through The Power of Nurses™. Our goals are to (1\) Elevate the Profession of Nursing Globally
   

  

* Evolve the Practice of Nursing to Improve Health, Health Care, and Health Equity and (3\) Ensure the Professional Success of Nurses. Our core values: Trusted, Inclusive, Innovative and Empowered guide everything we do. We are committed to creating a supportive and dynamic workplace where employees can thrive.


 We understand the importance of work\-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements and generous paid time off. Our modern office spaces are designed to foster collaboration and creativity. The collaborative culture and supportive team environment make ANE a great place to grow your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Data Management, Quality \& Analysis**
* Ensures data are accurate, reliable, and actionable to support operational and strategic initiatives.
* Collects, prepares, integrates, and validates data from multiple systems and sources.
* Monitors and maintains data quality standards, identifying and resolving inconsistencies or gaps.
* Performs exploratory and advanced analyses to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and business insights.
* Develops queries, data pipelines, and analytical processes that improve data accessibility and reliability.
* Establishes and maintains documentation related to data sources, definitions, methodologies, and processes.


**Test Security Analytics \& Data Forensics**
* Protects the integrity of certification programs through data\-driven detection and investigation of security risks.
* Analyzes examination and test taker data to identify patterns, anomalies, and indicators of potential misconduct or security threats.
* Designs and executes data forensic investigations to support test security reviews and incident response activities.
* Develops and refines statistical models, risk indicators, and monitoring methodologies to detect emerging threats.
* Partners with psychometric and test development teams to investigate suspicious testing activity and validate findings.
* Documents methodologies, findings, and recommendations to support decision\-making and audit requirements.


**Reporting, Visualization \& Stakeholder Communication**
* Transforms complex data into meaningful insights that support informed decisions across the organization.
* Develops and maintain recurring and ad hoc reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations.
* Translates complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations tailored to diverse audiences.
* Presents results to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership and cross \[1] functional teams.
* Defines and monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) related to test security, certification operations, and program effectiveness.
* Supports strategic planning and operational decision\-making through data\-driven insights.


**Research and Special Projects**
* Leads initiatives that enhance test security capabilities, operational effectiveness, and organizational performance.
* Collaborates across multiple workgroups to identify opportunities for increased efficiency, effectiveness, and risk mitigation.
* Evaluates existing processes and implements data\-driven solutions that improve operational outcomes.
* Recommends and supports the adoption of new analytical tools, methodologies, and best practices.
* Maintains awareness of industry trends and advancements, including data analysis techniques and processes. Shares findings with the department and applies this knowledge to enhance ANCC operations and inform product development.


**What You Bring To The American Nurses Enterprise**
**Education**
* Master’s Degree in Psychometrics, Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Industrial \[1] Organizational Psychology, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


**Related Work Experience**
* 3\-5 years data analysis, business intelligence, statistical analysis, or a related analytical role managing large datasets, or related field.
* Experience leading analytical projects from concept through implementation required. Strong reporting and data visualization skills required. Experience working in high\-stakes certification, credentialing, or assessment programs preferred.


**Certificates, Licenses And Registrations Required**
* Licensure: Current, unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in the U.S.
* Certification: ANCC professional nursing certification preferred; research certification considered within 2 years of hire.


**Computer Skills Required**
* Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques and data validation methodologies
* Experience working with large and complex datasets
* Demonstrated skill in using software packages for data analysis (e.g., R, SPSS, Winsteps)
* Fluency in using office computer software (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with data visualization and reporting tools
* Knowledge of psychometric, assessment, testing, or exam administration data (preferred)


**Other Skills Required**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Ability to identify meaningful trends, patterns, and anomalies within large datasets
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to present findings to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross\-functional teams
* Maintains confidentiality and handles sensitive information with discretion

* Commitment to continuous learning and process improvement
* Knowledge of descriptive and inferential statistics

Our work spans agentic solutions, AI enablement, AI\-native software, business transformation, small language models, strategy, governance, adoption, measurement, and executive advisory.
 



  




 About the Forward Deployed Engineering Team
 
 Our Forward Deployed Engineering team works with customers to turn business problems into secure, production\-ready AI. Engineers collaborate with users and operating teams to build, test, deploy, document, and improve solutions beyond the demo. You will learn Avanta Labs’ delivery patterns while building application components under experienced engineers.
 



  




 Role Summary
 
 You will build well\-scoped generative AI applications and integrations using approved architectures, managed services, and established engineering practices. You will contribute dependable code, thoughtful testing, clear documentation, and a positive customer experience.
 



  




 Role Mission
 
 Help customers move from a defined need to a working, supported AI capability—one reliable component at a time.
 



  




 What You Will Do
 * Build chatbots, copilots, assistants, and automations for repeatable business tasks.
* Integrate foundation\-model APIs and managed GenAI services into customer applications.
* Implement prompt templates, structured outputs, tool calls, and bounded conversational flows.
* Build basic Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using approved ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and citation patterns.
* Connect apps to APIs, databases, document repositories, SaaS tools, and approved enterprise data.
* Develop the UI, backend, API, or integration needed for an assigned feature.
* Deploy services using established cloud, container, authentication, secrets, storage, and monitoring patterns.
* Create evaluation examples, run predefined test suites, and document quality findings.
* Troubleshoot common prompt, retrieval, tool\-use, integration, latency, and model\-response problems.
* Contribute architecture notes, configurations, test evidence, runbooks, and customer documentation.
* Join code reviews, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and knowledge\-sharing.
* Raise security, privacy, quality, scalability, or delivery risks early; seek help when beyond your scope.



  




 Customer\-Facing Responsibilities
 * Join customer discovery sessions and ask clear questions about users, workflows, data, and expected outcomes.
* Translate well\-defined requirements into manageable technical tasks with support from the project lead.
* Demonstrate working features in language business users and engineers can follow.
* Track assigned actions, communicate progress, and surface blockers before they affect the customer timeline.
* Respond to feedback professionally and adjust implementation details without losing quality.
* Build trust through preparation, honesty, responsiveness, and reliable execution.
* Avoid overstating certainty, model capability, or delivery outcomes.



  




 Technical Responsibilities
 * Write maintainable, tested code in Python, TypeScript, Java, C\#, or a similar language.
* Use REST APIs, JSON, authentication, web services, and integration patterns.
* Apply version control, debugging, automated tests, code review, and CI/CD practices.
* Manage prompt templates and structured model outputs, including JSON validation and error handling.
* Apply foundational RAG concepts, including chunking, embeddings, semantic search, retrieval, context construction, and citations.
* Implement simple agents or workflow steps with a small number of approved tools and clearly bounded permissions.
* Add logging, metrics, traces, dashboards, and failure handling using established patterns.
* Follow Avanta Labs and customer standards for identity, access, secrets, sensitive data, responsible AI, and secure development.
* Compare model responses using defined quality criteria and explain observed trade\-offs.



  




 What This Role Is Not Expected to Own
 * Independently architecting a large multitenant AI platform or complex distributed system.
* Training a foundation model from scratch or selecting specialized hardware independently.
* Leading a major enterprise transformation, contractual scope negotiation, or high\-risk architecture decision without support.
* Owning an entire customer account, critical production escalation, or organization\-wide governance program.



  




 Required Qualifications
 * Approximately 1–3 years of relevant experience in software engineering, data, automation, machine learning, or equivalent practical work.
* Hands\-on exposure to generative AI through production work, internships, applied research, open\-source projects, or substantial personal projects.
* Sound programming fundamentals in Python, TypeScript, Java, C\#, or a comparable language.
* Working knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, debugging, version control, and cloud application delivery.
* Basic understanding of foundation models, prompts, RAG, vector search, agent tools, model limitations, and responsible\-AI risks.
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and communicate professionally with teammates and customer contributors.
* Demonstrated curiosity, reliability, attention to detail, and willingness to learn unfamiliar tools.
* Equivalent experience and demonstrated capability may substitute for a specific degree or tenure requirement.



  




 Preferred Qualifications
 * Internship or project experience delivering a generative AI, search, document\-processing, or productivity application.
* Experience with a frontend framework, enterprise identity system, vector database, or document\-ingestion pipeline.
* Cloud or developer certification relevant to the role.
* Open\-source contributions, research projects, hackathons, or technical writing that demonstrate practical learning.
* Experience supporting internal business users or customer\-facing technical teams.



  




 Representative Technologies
 
 Candidates do not need experience with every product below. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to learn equivalent technologies quickly.
 



**Languages and application development** 




 Python; TypeScript/JavaScript; Java; C\#; SQL; FastAPI; Flask; Node.js; React or comparable frameworks.
 



**Model platforms** 




 Amazon Bedrock; Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry; Google Vertex AI; OpenAI APIs; Anthropic APIs; Hugging Face; managed or open\-weight equivalents.
 



**RAG and application frameworks** 




 Native provider SDKs; LangChain; LangGraph; LlamaIndex; Semantic Kernel; Haystack; approved workflow frameworks.
 



**Retrieval and data** 




 PostgreSQL/pgvector; OpenSearch/Elasticsearch; Pinecone; Weaviate; Milvus; Qdrant; Redis; object storage; managed databases.
 



**Infrastructure and delivery** 




 Docker; serverless services; API gateways; GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD; basic Terraform or cloud\-native templates.
 



**Evaluation and observability** 




 Custom test harnesses; cloud\-native logging and monitoring; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus/Grafana; RAG evaluation tools.
 



**Security** 




 Identity and access management; role\-based access control; encryption; secrets management; audit logging; model guardrails.
 



  




 Core Competencies and Soft Skills
 * Curiosity and coachability.
* Reliable ownership of assigned work.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Empathy for users and customer teammates.
* Attention to detail and testing discipline.
* Collaborative problem\-solving.
* Comfort learning in a fast\-changing technical environment.
* Ability to work through ambiguity with guidance.
* Professional judgment about when to escalate.



  




 Scope, Autonomy, and Decision\-Making
 
 You will own clearly bounded features, integrations, tests, and documentation. A mid\-level or principal engineer will provide architectural direction and review higher\-risk decisions. You may recommend implementation changes, but you will not independently approve security\-sensitive designs, complex distributed architectures, unbounded agent actions, or major platform commitments.
 



  




 How Success Will Be Measured
 * Delivers components meeting functional, quality, security, and documentation standards.
* Writes tested, readable, maintainable code and responds constructively to review feedback.
* Resolves common defects and integration problems without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Runs evaluations accurately and records results in a form the team can use.
* Learns and applies Avanta Labs’ approved architectural and delivery patterns.
* Communicates progress and risk early enough for the team to act.
* Earns trust from colleagues and customer teams through reliable execution.



  




 Expected Outcomes During the First 6–12 Months
 * Ship components in a customer solution and support testing or production release.
* Build or extend one RAG application, workflow automation, or bounded agent using an approved reference pattern.
* Contribute reusable code, templates, tests, or documentation to Avanta Labs’ delivery library.
* Demonstrate sound handling of sensitive data, identity, secrets, logging, and model limitations.
* Present working features confidently and explain their operation to customers.
* Show readiness to own a small workstream with decreasing day\-to\-day supervision.



  




 Travel or Customer\-Site Expectations
 
 Travel may be needed for discovery, implementation, workshops, or go\-live support. Expectations and work\-location model will be confirmed before hire.
 



  




 Reporting Relationship
 
 Reports to a Forward Deployed Engineering lead, technical lead, or manager designated by Avanta Labs’ leadership. Final assignment to be confirmed.
 



  




 Compensation and Benefits
 
 Compensation and benefits are to be confirmed. Avanta Labs will share the employment structure, compensation, healthcare, paid time off, and benefits before an offer.

 Avanta Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any status protected by applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations throughout recruiting and employment. Candidates may request an accommodation when applying or interviewing.

 How You’ll Benefit

* Respond to data indicating risk to patients’ health and initiate action to correct, reduce or prevent risk.
* Seek supervision, consultation and assistance when unable to perform safely and independently.
* Document in patients’ medical records.

* New grad or less than one year RN work experience or if experience RN moving from non\-inpatient to acute direct care clinical inpatient setting with less than one year current acute direct patient care RN experience


 Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:
   

  

* Bachelor’s of Science in Nursing (BSN)

* Requires full range of body motion including handling and lifting patient, manual and finger dexterity, and eye\-hand coordination.

* Requires corrected vision and hearing to normal range.

* Exposure to communicable diseases and/or body fluids.
* Medium Work \- Exerting 20 to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 10 to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

* Follows Standard Precautions using personal protective equipment as required for procedures.

About the role
 
 You will contribute meaningfully to Whym’s backend. That means the services behind the product, the data layer that feeds them, and above all the features they power. Most of your time goes to shipping work users feel, like a new way to find something to do or a smoother path to a plan with friends.
 



 We expect most of your past work to be backend. We are looking for a strong generalist who has built serious backend systems and follows a feature all the way to the person using it. When a feature needs frontend work, you flex into the client and ship it yourself.
 



  





 This is a tiny startup. Everyone does customer support, including the CEO and CTO. You will too. Some weeks you will design a schema; other weeks you will debug a deploy, ship a feature end to end, or sit with a user to understand why a flow broke. You should find that appealing, not beneath you.
 



  




 What you'll work on
 
  




* Feature development. Ship user\-facing features end to end. When Whym adds a new way to plan an outing with friends, you design the API, model the data, build the service behind it, and see it through to launch.
* Backend services and APIs. Design and run the services Whym depends on. You handle data modeling, async work, performance, and reliability, and you own how the client and server fit together.
* Data for search and discovery. Help build the plumbing that moves activity data, user signals, and analytics through the system.
* Infra and developer experience. Touch CI, observability, and deploy when it unblocks the team. Raise the floor on how fast we can ship without breaking things.
* Prototypes and research. Build throwaway prototypes to answer product questions. Sit in on user research and let what you hear change what you build.
* Product and design calls. Make product and technical decisions independently when needed. You have good product sense.



  




 What we’re looking for
 * 8\+ years in engineering, most of it building backend systems that shipped to production. We want to hear about specific systems you built end to end, the decisions you made, and how they held up under real users.
* Strong backend foundations. You can design a service, model the data, reason about async behavior, and debug a performance regression. You do not need a platform team to get work done.
* A feature builder at heart. You measure your work by what a user can do after it ships, and you are happy owning a feature from the first API sketch to launch.
* Strong product instinct. You connect what you build to what users feel. You know which detail matters and can say why in plain language.
* AI\-native. You use modern AI tools in your daily work and have opinions about which ones earn their keep. You know what AI slop looks like and you do not turn it in as final work.
* Clear writer and communicator. You document decisions. You disagree without posturing.
* Comfortable with ambiguity. You thrive at early stage, and drive forward towards good outcomes.
* High agency. You notice what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked.



  




 Strong pluses
 * Experience with data infrastructure. You can design a pipeline, debug a schema, and argue for or against owning an index.
* Experience with search, feed, recommender, or ranking systems.
* Experience with frontend and/or mobile development.
* Experience with offline\-first, real\-time, or location\-based products.
* Experience with voice, multimodal, or agent\-driven interfaces.
* Experience owning infra and developer tooling, including CI, observability, and deploy pipelines.
* Experience at an early\-stage startup where you wore many hats.
* Experience building processes that scale and documenting what you build.



  




 Location and working model
 
 Whym is a hybrid team based in Oakland, California and Bend, Oregon. We work together in person three days a week and reserve the other days for focused remote work. We prefer candidates who can work with us at our hubs, but will make room for exceptional candidates who want to be fully remote. Bend\-based and remote teammates travel to the Bay Area regularly so the whole team can spend time together.
 



  




 About Whym
 
 Whym is an AI\-powered app that helps people make time for what matters most. We suggest activities aligned with your values and help you coordinate plans with close friends. We are a three\-person founding team with experience from Google, LinkedIn, Lyft, and earlier\-stage startups. Whym is a Public Benefit Corporation with pre\-seed funding.

**Role Overview:**
 This is not a traditional eCRF\-only Data Manager role. We are hiring a data\-science\-capable leader who can build and run research databases, operationalize EHR→EDC automation — including hands\-on transformation of raw EHR data pulls into EDC\-ready, analysis\-ready datasets — and own data quality through data lock, while performing light\-to\-moderate statistical analysis as needed. This position plays a critical role in driving Viz's Evidence Generation strategy by managing the full data life\-cycle for clinical research and quality improvement studies, from raw source extraction through database build, cleaning, transformation, and downstream analysis. This role requires expertise in creating sophisticated data management systems, building and running ETL/data transformation pipelines against raw EHR extracts, performing statistical analyses, automating data integrations, and ensuring robust data integrity practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Research Database Build \& Full Data Management**
* Configure/maintain EDC forms and eCRF specifications as needed to support ingestion and downstream analysis, focusing on scalability and standardization.
* Own end\-to\-end Data Management for Evidence Generation studies: build, validate, and maintain research databases from ingest → cleaning → QC → data lock.
* Develop and run data cleaning workflows (queries, reconciliation, audit trails), and ensure inspection\-ready documentation.


**Raw EHR Data Transformation \& EDC\-Ready Dataset Engineering**
* Pull, parse, and profile EHR datapulls (e.g., FHIR bundles, HL7v2 messages, flat\-file/CSV extracts) directly from site or enterprise data sources.
* Design and build transformation pipelines (Python/SQL) that clean, standardize, and reshape raw EHR extracts into structured, validated, EDC\-ready datasets — including field mapping, unit harmonization, deduplication, and derivation logic.
* Establish repeatable, version\-controlled transformation code (not one\-off scripts) so pipelines can be re\-run reliably as new EHR extracts arrive across sites and studies.


**EHR → EDC Auto\-Import \& Data Model Strategy**
* Design and operate data model strategy for automated ingestion of EHR\-level RWE into the EDC.
* Work hands\-on with APIs/integration endpoints and unify disparate data models (site/EHR variability, mapping logic, versioning, schema evolution).


**EHR Systems Fluency / Site Data Reality**
* Partner with site IT/informatics and the Product team to understand EHR constraints, extract structures, and change management.
* Translate EHR data realities into feasible study data capture and monitoring plans.


**Collateral, SOPs, and Enablement**
* Create and maintain DMPs, SAPs, SOPs, runbooks, transformation/mapping specs, and training materials that operationalize the above processes across care pathways.


**Data Science \& Statistical Analysis**
* Perform statistical analyses on cleaned, transformed datasets (descriptive, comparative, time\-to\-event where appropriate) and support evidence packages and reporting.
* Apply data science techniques (feature/cohort derivation, exploratory data analysis, data quality scoring) to raw EHR\-derived datasets to accelerate study readiness and reduce manual review burden.


**You Will Thrive in This Role If:**
* You possess advanced analytical capabilities, enjoy solving complex data problems, and have a deep interest in clinical research methodologies and outcomes.
* You enjoy getting hands\-on with messy, raw EHR extracts and take satisfaction in turning them into clean, structured, analysis\-ready datasets.
* You are proficient in developing automated and scalable data solutions, and possess strong coding and database management skills (e.g., SQL, SAS, Python, R).
* You excel in strategic thinking and operational execution, adept at balancing immediate data management needs with long\-term data infrastructure goals.
* You are highly organized, methodical, and meticulous about data integrity, compliance, and documentation standards.
* You enjoy collaborating with diverse stakeholders, effectively translating complex statistical concepts into actionable insights that drive clinical research forward.


**Qualifications:**
**Required**
* 5–7\+ years in clinical research/RWE data management with hands\-on database build \+ cleaning/QC ownership.
* SQL \+ Python (or R) for data transformation, ETL pipeline development, QC checks, and reproducible pipelines.
* Direct, hands\-on experience transforming raw EHR extracts (FHIR, HL7v2, or flat\-file exports) into structured, analysis/EDC\-ready datasets.
* Experience with EHR or EHR\-derived datasets and understanding of common structures/coding systems (ICD\-10, CPT, LOINC, RxNorm preferred).
* Practical familiarity with API\-based ingestion and integrating multiple data sources/models.
* Experience building/owning DMPs/SOPs/runbooks and maintaining audit\-ready documentation.
* Working knowledge of version control and reproducible\-pipeline practices (e.g., Git) to keep transformation code auditable.
* Familiarity with integrating leading AI techniques into your work product.


**Preferred**
* Experience with EDC platforms (Medidata Rave, REDCap, Castor, Veeva, etc.).
* CDISC familiarity (SDTM/ADaM) or strong equivalent standardization experience.
* Stats experience in real\-world/implementation studies (propensity methods, time\-to\-event, mixed models) — not required to be a PhD biostatistician.
* Experience with pipeline orchestration/data engineering tooling and cloud (AWS) data warehouses.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You are energized by building scalable, audit\-ready Evidence Generation data systems; turning raw EHR\-derived real\-world data into clean, analysis\-ready research datasets with minimal manual effort.
* You take end\-to\-end ownership of Research Databases (ingest → validation → cleaning → QC → data lock), and you continuously improve the EHR→Viz→EDC auto\-import pipeline by designing resilient mappings, unifying disparate data models, and proactively troubleshooting data issues with sites and internal partners.
* You communicate clearly, document rigorously, and train teammates through lightweight SOPs, runbooks, and templates so the work scales across multiple care pathways.
* You manage competing priorities well and deliver on\-time, high\-quality outputs that support study milestones and sponsor expectations, while consistently practicing Viz core values.
* After 90 days: there is visible improvement in data management execution — standardized database templates are in use, an agreed SDV/QA approach is documented, a first raw\-EHR\-to\-EDC transformation pipeline is built and validated for at least one care pathway, automated import performance is measured and improving, and stakeholders see faster turnaround on monitoring/cleaning and sponsor\-ready reporting (with clear audit trails and reproducible outputs).
